sources.snippet: Project Panini: Neuro-Symbolic Sanskrit SLM 🕉️ Panini-1 is an open-source initiative to build a high-fidelity Small Language Model (SLM) for Sanskrit. Unlike standard LLMs that require millions of dollars to "guess" grammar from massive datasets, we use a Neuro-Symbolic approach.
